summary: Backend testing of Organization Member Management and Custom Roles completed successfully. All 13 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified: GET /api/org/members with include_suspended param, role_name/role_name_es resolution, GET /api/settings/roles returns custom roles, PUT /api/org/members/{id}/role accepts custom roles, PUT /api/org/members/{id} updates name/phone, PUT /api/org/members/{id}/suspend, PUT /api/org/members/{id}/activate, and POST /api/org/members/create-direct accepts custom roles.

GET /api/org/members.description: Returns list of org members with role_name and role_name_es resolved

GET /api/org/members?include_suspended=t.description: Includes both active and suspended members

GET /api/settings/roles.description: Returns system roles and custom roles for the company

PUT /api/org/members/{membership_id}/rol.description: Updates member role, accepts both system and custom role_ids

POST /api/org/members/create-direct.description: Creates new user with password and role (accepts system and custom roles)

critical_code_review_comments: All endpoints correctly validate custom roles against db.roles collection
role_name and role_name_es are properly resolved from custom_roles_map
Suspend/activate endpoints have proper permission checks and prevent owner/self suspension
include_suspended query param correctly uses $in filter for ['active', 'suspended']
Invalid roles are rejected with 400 status code
The 'sales' role was confirmed present in ROLE_PERMISSIONS
seed_data_creation: Created test users with custom and system roles, all cleaned up in final test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Org member management and custom roles feature verified. Endpoints: GET /api/org/members (accepts ?include_suspended=true), GET /api/settings/roles, POST /api/settings/roles, PUT /api/org/members/{id}/role (query param role=), PUT /api/org/members/{id} (JSON body with name/phone), PUT /api/org/members/{id}/suspend, PUT /api/org/members/{id}/activate, POST /api/org/members/create-direct. Custom roles are stored in db.roles collection with role_id. System roles are: admin, sales, finance, operations, viewer, marketing_partner, owner.
